mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ms_test t1 WHERE t1.subject_id = #{subjectId}

SELECT ms_test.test_name, ms_test.subject_id, ms_subjects.grade, ms_test.test_type, ms_test.suggest_duration, ms_test_question.`order`, ms_test_question.big_title, ms_question.question_title, ms_question.`option` FROM ms_test INNER JOIN ms_test_question ON ms_test.test_id = ms_test_question.test_id INNER JOIN ms_subjects ON ms_test.subject_id = ms_subjects.subject_id INNER JOIN ms_question ON ms_test_question.question_id = ms_question.question_id AND ms_subjects.subject_id = ms_question.subject_id WHERE ms_test.test_id = #{testId}
